# BNP Coorporation Sarl (BNPC)

> BNP Coorporation Sarl (BNPC) is a multiservice engineering company based in Yaoundé, Cameroon, founded in 2023. Active in Yaoundé, Douala, Kribi and across Cameroon. Expertise: fire safety (SSIAP training, ERP audits), construction (BTP), water drilling, renewable energy (solar), drones and aerial imaging, naval repair, industrial cleaning. Contact: contact@bnp-coorporation.com, (+237) 6 55 01 09 19, BP 4219 Yaoundé. Hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-16:00, Sat 8:00-12:00. Languages: French (default), English. Independent Cameroonian company, no link with BNP Paribas nor BNP Paribas Corporate.

## Services (FR)

- [Sécurité incendie](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/securite-incendie): audits ERP, ingénierie SSIAP, équipements et formations.
- [Construction (BTP)](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/construction-btp): bâtiment, génie civil, rénovation.
- [Forage et eau](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/forage-et-eau): études géophysiques, forage, potabilisation, pompage solaire.
- [Énergies renouvelables](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/energies-renouvelables): centrales solaires, stockage, maintenance.
- [Drones (imagerie aérienne)](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/drones-imagerie-aerienne): cartographie 3D, inspection, suivi de chantier.
- [Réparation navale](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/reparation-navale): ports de Kribi et Douala.
- [Nettoyage industriel](https://bnp-coorporation.com/fr/services/nettoyage-industriel): sites industriels et tertiaires.

## Services (EN)

- [Fire Safety](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/securite-incendie): ERP audits, SSIAP engineering, equipment and training.
- [Construction](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/construction-btp): building, civil engineering, renovation.
- [Drilling and Water](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/forage-et-eau): geophysical surveys, drilling, potabilization, solar pumping.
- [Renewable Energy](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/energies-renouvelables): solar plants, storage, maintenance.
- [Drones (Aerial Imaging)](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/drones-imagerie-aerienne): 3D mapping, inspection, site monitoring.
- [Naval Repair](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/reparation-navale): ports of Kribi and Douala.
- [Industrial Cleaning](https://bnp-coorporation.com/en/services/nettoyage-industriel): industrial and commercial sites.
